Fix: Implement true snapshot reads at specified timestamp using SQL temporal queries. Complexity: M. Tests: Verify temporal consistency of authorization checks.

title: CRITICAL: Revert Fireflies to use static timeToLive - safety violation
description:
Delos-868.18 introduced a safety violation in Fireflies by using dynamicTimeToLive() instead of static timeToLive() for RoundScheduler timing.

PROBLEM:
- Fireflies uses RoundScheduler for consensus-critical timers (rebuttalTimeout, finalizeViewRounds, viewChangeRounds)
- These timers rely on TTL to ensure message propagation before timeout
- dynamicTimeToLive() uses activeCount() which changes during gossip
- roundDuration is only updated on view changes, not membership changes
- During network growth, stale (shorter) roundDuration can cause:
  - Honest members marked dead before rebuttal propagates
  - View divergence if different members have different TTL calculations
  - Byzantine attack amplification

FIX:
Revert View.java lines 128 and 511 to use context.timeToLive() instead of context.dynamicTimeToLive()

ANALYSIS:
CHOAM correctly uses static timeToLive() for its RoundScheduler - Fireflies should do the same for safety-critical timers.
